title: Opinion: Blog | Why You Should Care Whether Schrodinger's Cat Is Dead Or Alive
summary_full: Imagine going on a romantic Alpine getaway and returning with the equation that runs the modern world. The only snag: nobody can quite agree on what it says about reality.
